subject.title: Feature Request: Add Anthropic native web search (web_search_20260209) as a search provider

question: Should OpenClaw support Anthropic native web search as its own near-term provider feature, or should this request be folded into the broader Anthropic server-tools design before implementation?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API/config shape touches provider routing, hosted web access, encrypted result replay, billing visibility, and security defaults, so automation should not choose the product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow native-search design
options.body: Define a plugin-owned Anthropic web-search provider with explicit opt-in config, domain/max-use handling, server-result replay policy, docs, and live proof before landing a fresh implementation.

options.title: Fold into the broad server-tools tracker
options.body: Close or mark this issue as covered only after preserving the web-search requirements in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/23353 alongside web_fetch and code_execution/PTC.

options.title: Defer Anthropic native tools
options.body: Keep existing managed providers as the supported path and document that Anthropic native server tools are not planned until a security and replay model is chosen.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow native-search design
recommendation.body: Define a plugin-owned Anthropic web-search provider with explicit opt-in config, domain/max-use handling, server-result replay policy, docs, and live proof before landing a fresh implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the most visible product-boundary review context for the broader Anthropic server-tools discussion.
